title: Joint bicarbonate–anion-gap nonadditivity adds no clear cross-cycle CRP prediction
abstract: In NHANES2007–2008 to2009–2010 adult samples with CRP≤10mg/L, a source-centered albumin-corrected-anion-gap × bicarbonate term beyond flexible additive standard measures gave weighted Brier improvement 0.00001582 (95% joint PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00054934 to 0.00037084) for CRP>3mg/L, providing no clear incremental predictive evidence.
